Voat is small enough to have a different and more selective user group. This is important not just in the type of content, but the user participation, which affects the upvoting scheme.

Let's say that a constant percentage p of users will post articles / comments when they read them.

When a community is small, lets say 100, then we will have 10 posts, and 90 votes to go around. When a community is bigger, lets say 1000, then we have 100 posts, and 900 votes to go around.

but the front page size is constant, only the first 10 posts matter ( or whatever the front page amount is), so the voting style and importance is way different.
